speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have a pain in the head. I am going.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Behind the eyes. It's full of gnats.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: Then you have caught them, and you are welcome to the swarm. I had a fourth pint in mind.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The fourth can wait for a night with fewer of them. The shilling is paid.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: Paid, and eaten. Go. I will not call for it.
